summary: Pacific Booker Minerals Inc. filed Form 6-K to confirm termination of an unsolicited take-over bid by American Eagle Gold Corp. The hostile bid, whose terms were not specified in this filing, was terminated effective immediately per American Eagle's announcement. Pacific Booker will continue its previously announced strategic review process led by an independent Special Committee. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms were disclosed. The filing also corrects a prior misstatement about a Technical Advisory Board member's professional designation. Key risks to watch include the outcome of the strategic review and potential new offers.
